up: Return the count of IC50 activities for each target type. Use the target types from the target_dictionary table. The counts should reflect the number of activity records associated with assays linked to each target type.
sql: SELECT td.target_type, COUNT(a.activity_id) AS activity_count FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' GROUP BY td.target_type ORDER BY activity_count DESC;
